basic_details.job_title: CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I (PAT - I) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Project Associate - I (PAT - I) is required for the CSIR-sponsored project OLP2304, "Development of multi-functional glasses for strategic, optics and renewable energy & smart applications", at CSIR-Central Glass & Ceramic Research Institute (CSIR-CGCRI), Kolkata, initially for 1 year and extendable up to 31.03.2031 based on the availability of fund. The stipend is Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for NET/GATE qualified candidates, or Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others, and the essential qualification is an M.Sc in Chemistry / Physics / Materials Science or a B.E./B.Tech in Ceramic Engg. / Ceramic Technology

important_dates.interview_date: 02/12/2026, from 11.00 a.m. (report at least one hour earlier)

age_limit.details: The age limit is 35 Years, as on the date of interview. | Category Relaxation SC / ST / Physically Handicapped / Female Up to 5 years OBC (Non-Creamy layer) 3 years

qualification.details: M.Sc in Chemistry / Physics / Materials Science Or, B.E./ B.Tech in Ceramic Engg./ Ceramic Technology/ Materials Science/ Metallurgy & Materials Engineering or equivalent | Candidates whose results are awaited will not be eligible. Candidates holding CGPA/DGPA must calculate the percentage as per the calculation rule of their University/Institute and attach a self-attested soft copy of that rule. For full details of the eligibility for this post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

how_to_apply: Fill the Application Form in the prescribed format furnished with the notice, duly TYPED (not hand-written).
Prepare soft copies of self-attested copies of each supporting document, certificate and reprint.
If your marks are in CGPA/DGPA, attach a self-attested soft copy of your University/Institute's conversion rule.
If you are presently engaged in any project, in CSIR-CGCRI or any other organisation, lab or institute, attach a copy of the NOC from your existing Project Leader.
Email the soft copy of the application with the attachments to [email protected] so that it is received by 30/11/2026.
Send a separate application if you apply for more than one position or Advt. No.
Incomplete applications without the prescribed format and supporting documents will be summarily rejected, and no application will be entertained after the prescribed date.
Typed application form in the prescribed format
Self-attested copies of supporting documents, certificates and reprints (soft copies with the email)
NOC from the existing Project Leader (only for candidates presently engaged in a project)
Self-attested copy of the CGPA/DGPA conversion rule (where applicable)
At the interview: original marksheets, certificates and age-caste proof, self-attested copies of all documents and project thesis (if any)
important_instructions: CSIR-CGCRI reserves the right not to fill up the position, if so desired by the Competent Authority. The number of positions may increase or decrease as per the requirement of the Institute; the decision of the Institute shall be final. Interim enquiries will not be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: M.Sc in Chemistry / Physics / Materials Science Or, B.E./ B.Tech in Ceramic Engg./ Ceramic Technology/ Materials Science/ Metallurgy & Materials Engineering or equivalent Candidates whose results are awaited will not be eligible. Candidates holding CGPA/DGPA must calculate the percentage as per the calculation rule of their University/Institute and attach a self-attested soft copy of that rule. The engagement is for bonafide Indian citizens.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The stipend for the Project Associate - I (PAT - I) depends on whether the candidate has qualified a national-level test: HRA is paid in addition to the stipend in both cases. The engagement is initially for 1 Year and is extendable upto 31.03.2031 based on the availability of fund in the project.

rows.candidate: Qualified CSIR-UGC/ ICAR/ ICMR NET including Lectureship / Assistant Professorship, or GATE, or National Level Examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/ DST or equivalent and or their Agencies/ Institutions
Others who do not fall under the above

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in-interview to be held on 2 December 2026 from 11.00 a.m. at CSIR-Central Glass & Ceramic Research Institute, 196, Raja S. C. Mullick Road, Kolkata-32. Candidates must report at least ONE HOUR before the scheduled time of interview for verification of documents, bringing their original marksheets, certificates and age-caste proof. No candidate will be allowed to enter the Institute if arriving after the reporting time.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-CGCRI Recruitment 2026 for Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: There is one (01) Project Associate - I (PAT - I) post under Advt. No. 59/2627/SGD/OLP2304/AKM, Post Code 59/2627/01.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: The application must be received via email by 30 November 2026; no application will be entertained after that date.

faq.question: Q3. When is the CSIR-CGCRI walk-in-interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in-interview will be held on 2 December 2026 from 11.00 a.m. at CSIR-CGCRI, Kolkata, and candidates must report at least one hour before the scheduled time.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: An M.Sc in Chemistry / Physics / Materials Science, or a B.E./B.Tech in Ceramic Engg. / Ceramic Technology / Materials Science / Metallurgy & Materials Engineering or equivalent.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 35 Years as on the date of interview, relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/Physically Handicapped and Female candidates and 3 years for OBC (Non-Creamy layer) candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for NET/GATE or equivalent qualified candidates, and Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the stipend?
faq.answer: Yes, HRA is paid in addition to both stipend rates of Rs. 31,000/- and Rs. 25,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I post?
faq.answer: Email the typed application form in the prescribed format, with self-attested soft copies of all supporting documents, to [email protected] by 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a project position, initially for 1 year and extendable up to 31.03.2031 based on the availability of fund.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates with results awaited apply?
faq.answer: No, candidates with results awaited will not be eligible for the CSIR-CGCRI Project Associate - I post.
